replies.body:
+1 to new hub, -1 to community.

It would be hard and time consuming to find and pick all the people to build it, as well as having someone manage it and plan what it's going to look like.

Yeah it brings the community together, but it's not worth the time and hassle.

Hyperscale has done a fine job on our hub, it's way easier just to pay them then organize a massive event like this.
